title: Swiss tourist killed and British and Americans injured by elephants in Cameroon
summary_full: Alain Throo, insurance executive based in London, reportedly gored and later died on hike near Mount Cameroon national parkA Swiss tourist has been killed and British and American tourists have been injured when a group of hikers encountered a herd of elephants in Cameroon.The group of six tourists, four British, one Swiss and one American, accompanied by local guides, were hiking near the village of Bakingili in the south of the Mount Cameroon national park on 19 November, on a path used by elephants to access a nearby lake, when they encountered the herd of about 15 animals, according to media reports.
